fusions.name: Arm's Length
fusions.desc: Reaches out to a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Eight-Way Lunge
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 5 tiles onto the target and deals 13 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Knot
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 8%.
